prerequisites: Mathematics A from the Portuguese High School Curriculum.

learning_outcomes.text: Solve and classify linear systems using Gauss elimination and matrix operations
Compute 2 by 2 and 3 by 3 determinants and expand any determinant using the Laplace expansion
Study the invertibility of a matrix using the rank or the determinant
Compute the inverse of a matrix of order 2 or 3 using the Gauss-Jordan method
Compute a basis and the dimension of a subspace in Rn and apply the Gram-Schmidt orthonormalisation process
Use the method of least squares to determine approximate solutions of linear systems
Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors and determine whether a given matrix is diagonalisable
Apply the acquired knowledge to solving problems in science and engineering

syllabus_topics: Vector Spaces with an Inner Product
teaching_methods: Example classes (problem solving by students under guidance)
assessment_rules: The assessment can be done through continuous assessment or final assessment. For continuous assessment, 2 or more midterm exams account for 100% of the grade. For final assessment, a single exam accounts for 100% of the grade.
